    event_image = { video = "unspecific_politicians_arguing" }
    title = ywc_tib.1128.t
    desc = ywc_tib.1128.d
    trigger = { AND = { c:TIB ?= this ywc_v03_can_deliver_major = yes has_variable = ywc_v03_tib_v03_tib_public_revenue_started NOT = { has_variable = ywc_v03_tib_v03_tib_public_revenue_settled }
         OR = { ywc_v03_tib_inline_dispatch_75 = yes } } }
    immediate = { if = { limit = { OR = { ywc_v03_tib_inline_dispatch_75 = yes }} ywc_v03_mark_major_delivered = yes ywc_tib_revenue_stamp_1128 = yes
        ywc_v03_tib_inline_body_return_75 = yes
        ywc_v03_tib_inline_callback_75 = yes } }
    option = {
        name = ywc_tib.1128.review_next
        trigger = { ywc_tib_revenue_at_1128 = yes ywc_tib_revenue_route_execution_ready = yes ywc_tib_finance_safe = yes has_variable = ywc_tib_revenue_adjust_cost var:ywc_tib_revenue_adjust_cost > 0 gold_reserves >= var:ywc_tib_revenue_adjust_cost }
        ai_chance = { base = 55 }
        custom_tooltip = { text = ywc_tib.1128.review_next.cost_tooltip }
        custom_tooltip = { text = ywc_tib.1128.review_next.consequence_tooltip }
        ywc_tib_revenue_progress_7 = yes
    }
    option = {
        name = ywc_tib.1128.defer
        trigger = { ywc_tib_revenue_at_1128 = yes }
        ai_chance = { base = 12 }
        custom_tooltip = { text = ywc_tib.1128.defer.cost_tooltip }
        custom_tooltip = { text = ywc_tib.1128.defer.consequence_tooltip }
        ywc_tib_revenue_wait_1128 = yes
    }
    option = {
        name = ywc_tib.1128.withdraw
        trigger = { ywc_tib_revenue_at_1128 = yes }
        ai_chance = { base = 5 }
        custom_tooltip = { text = ywc_tib.1128.withdraw.cost_tooltip }
        custom_tooltip = { text = ywc_tib.1128.withdraw.consequence_tooltip }
        ywc_tib_revenue_withdraw_1128 = yes
    }
}
